info.title: Atlas Protocol
info.description: Unpublished S1 development edition. It defines the direct-IP Asset-to-Core Move To workflow routes; later slices add their own routes and variants.

get.summary: List Entities ordered by permanent ID

post.summary: Register an Asset under its enrolled identity
post.description: Ordinary Entity creation. First Enrollment presents deployment enrollment authorization with the Asset's prepared credential; re-registration presents the surviving Asset credential. A matching registration retry returns the original association and the current Entity.

200.description: Replayed registration with the current Entity

patch.summary: Apply one mutation class: a Descriptive edit or an Asset report
patch.description: Descriptive edits carry expected_edit_revision. Asset reports carry report_context and only Reported fields. Mixed classes, Derived and immutable fields reject the whole request.

200.description: Committed Entity, with the report result for an Asset report

delete.summary: Delete an Entity; Asset deletion revokes its bound credentials

post.summary: Report current Asset data; a first report may establish process authority

200.description: Accepted or duplicate report with the current Entity

get.summary: Read an Asset's Operational status and its report times

patch.summary: Report a complete Operational status record

200.description: Accepted or duplicate report with the current Entity

get.summary: Read an Asset's assigned Tasks in default requested order
get.description: Listing does not acknowledge, start or adopt work. Every page token pins the Asset's queue revision.

200.description: Assigned Task page and queue aggregate

get.summary: Read retained movement samples for one Entity
List Tasks ordered by permanent ID

post.summary: Create one Task for one Asset, including while it is offline

200.description: Replayed Task for a matching creation identity

patch.summary: Request cancellation, or report the assigned Asset's lifecycle evidence
patch.description: Not a generic status setter. Tasking clients request cancellation; only the assigned Asset reports acknowledgement, execution, progress, outcomes and cancellation confirmation or decline.

get.summary: Discover the current Dataset and supported editions; Assets may request a contact challenge
get.description: Requires authentication and no Dataset precondition. Enrollment authorization may discover before first Enrollment. A contact challenge is proof for a later fresh report, not Contact itself.
The HTML exception to the JSON envelope. The shell contains no schema; the entered key stays in page memory and authorizes fetching /openapi.json.

200.description: Documentation shell for an authenticated caller

401.description: Key-entry shell without schema or operational data

get.summary: Raw OpenAPI document without the JSON success envelope

bearer.description: Operator API key or Asset credential

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: Operator API key or Asset credential

enrollment.name: Atlas-Enrollment
enrollment.description: Deployment enrollment authorization for one Asset ID: unpadded base64url of the RFC 8785 canonical EnrollmentAuthorization. It authenticates discovery and first Enrollment only.

Timestamp.description: A UTC instant from the authoring participant's deployment-provided clock.

NullablePosition.description: A complete Position, or null to remove the reported position.

Altitude.description: Height in metres above the WGS84 ellipsoid, never implicitly mean sea level or ground height.

MoveToGeofeatureTarget.description: Structural identity only. Task admission must resolve a live point Geofeature.

MoveTo.description: Representative input binding only. Task admission, validity, references and execution remain operational work.

Pause.description: Representative tagged input binding only. Control ordering, validity and suspension remain operational work.

ClockUncertainty.description: Optional compatibility metadata under ADR-0029. Core neither computes it nor uses it for freshness or age.

Ed25519Signature.description: Unpadded base64url Ed25519 signature over RFC 8785 canonical facts.

CredentialSecret.description: A caller-prepared secret of at least 32 random bytes in unpadded base64url. Core stores only a verifier.

EntityType.description: S1 implements Asset Entities. Track and Geofeature variants belong to S6.

AssetStatus.description: Reported Operational status with its source report time and Core receipt/change times.

AssetStatusReport.description: A complete Operational status record. Null in a patch attempts to remove the required component and is rejected.

AssetHeartbeat.description: Contact: Core receipt time of the latest fresh accepted report.

Heading.description: Degrees clockwise from true north, 0 inclusive to 360 exclusive.

AssetTelemetry.description: Reported movement telemetry. Absent quantities are unknown, never zero-filled.

TelemetryPatch.description: Partial telemetry. Omission preserves a quantity, null removes it, and null for the whole object removes telemetry.

ComponentsPatch.description: Components named in a request. Communication state and Contact are Derived and are declared only so Core can reject them as forbidden fields.

CommandManifest.description: Asset-reported subset of Catalog Commands. Each Command appears at most once.

ReportingUnit.description: Core-owned metadata for the report that supplied a unit's current value.

EntityReporting.description: Reporting units with an applied report. Empty before the first report.

TaskQueue.description: Tasks-owned Derived queue aggregate. Requested order is not Asset adoption; confirmed evidence stays null until the Asset reports adoption.

EnrollmentAuthorization.description: Deployment authorization for first Enrollment of one Asset ID with its recovery public key, signed by the installation's enrollment authority over RFC 8785 canonical facts.

AssetEnrollment.description: First Enrollment's prepared Asset credential, presented with enrollment authorization in the Atlas-Enrollment header.

EntityCreate.description: Registration carries only Descriptive data and Command support. Reported and Derived fields are declared only so Core can reject them atomically.

EntityPatch.description: Exactly one mutation class: Descriptive (alias/subtype with expected_edit_revision) or Asset Reported (report_context with command_manifest/components). Immutable and Derived fields are declared only so Core can reject them.

AuthorityClaim.description: Process-authority claim carried by the first signed check-in of a reporting process. recovery_proof signs the claim without its proof, bound to the report digest, Dataset and Asset.

ReportResult.description: Acceptance receipt. It is not a synchronization input.

PageToken.description: Opaque continuation bound to its Dataset, resource, filters and page size.

TaskLifecycleEvent.description: Asset event time from its correct clock and Core receipt time.

MoveToProgressDetails.description: Asset-selected Move To progress. Core does not compare it with an arrival rule.

TaskCancellation.description: A recorded cancellation request. Closed means another terminal outcome resolved the Task first.

TaskCreate.description: S1 admits queued Move To with a named position target. Omitted scheduling selects queued.

MovementSample.description: Raw supplied movement quantities from one accepted report, with their own observation times and Core receipt time.

ContactChallenge.description: Opaque proof bound to the Dataset, Asset, generation and current Core run. Its interval bounds a fresh report's original generated_at.

Error.description: Typed JSON error. Context headers are present when Core can attribute them to the caller's request.

Atlas-Commit-Cursor.description: Committed cursor for a successful mutation without a JSON body.

Accept-Encoding.description: Request content codings Core accepts for JSON bodies (RFC 9110 section 12.5.3).
